transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess what really scared me is I’ve been hearing my name called when nobody’s there. At home, from the hallway, and once at the warehouse. It sounds… real, like someone’s standing right next to me.
What does the voice say when it calls your name?
It just says my name. That’s all… but it sounds real, like someone’s right there next to me. At home it’s from the hallway, and once at work too.
Are you usually alone when you hear your name being called?
Usually, yeah. At home nobody’s in the hallway when it happens. And that one time at the warehouse, I checked… no one was there. It sounds real, though, like my husband standing right next to me.
Does the voice ever tell you to do something when it calls your name?
No… it doesn’t tell me to do anything. It’s just my name, like someone’s calling me from the hall or standing right there. That’s what scares me.
Do you see anything when you hear your name being called?
No… I don’t see anything. I just hear my name, like it’s coming from the hallway or right next to me. That’s what scares me.
How often do you hear your name being called?
Not every day… but enough that it scared me. Mostly at home from the hallway, and once at the warehouse. It’s happened a few times.
Do you ever hear anything else besides your name being called when nobody's there?
Not really… it’s mostly just my name. Like from the hallway at home, and that one time at work. It sounds real, like my husband is right next to me, but nobody’s there.
Do you ever see things that aren't really there?
No… I don’t think I see things. It’s more the hearing my name, like from the hallway at home, or that time at the warehouse. That’s what scared me.
Do these voices calling your name cause you any distress or affect your daily activities?

Yeah… it does bother me. It scared me enough to come in, because it sounds so real—like my husband is right there calling me from the hallway, but nobody’s there. And once it happened at the warehouse too, so… yeah, it’s hard to just ignore.
Is it always the same voice that calls your name?

I’m not totally sure… it usually sounds like my husband, like he’s right there in the hallway. The time at the warehouse, it was still my name, but I don’t know if I’d say it was exactly the same. It just sounded real.
Is the voice that calls your name always the same?

Not always, I don’t think. At home it sounds like my husband calling me from the hallway… real close, like he’s right there. The warehouse one, I’m not sure whose voice it was, just my name. It sounded real.
Do the voices ever comment on what you're doing?

No… not really commenting. It’s more just my name being called, like from the hallway at home. It sounds so real, like my husband is right there, but nobody’s there. Once it happened at the warehouse too.
How long does the voice last when it calls your name?
Just a second or two, I guess. It’s like I hear my name, clear as if he’s right there, and then it’s gone.
Do you feel like the voice calling your name is coming from inside your head or from outside?
Outside, I think. Like from the hallway… or at work that one time. It doesn’t feel like it’s in my head. It sounds real, like someone’s right there.
When you hear your name being called, do you hear it in one ear or both ears?
I’m not really sure… I don’t notice it in just one ear. It’s more like it’s out in the hallway, like someone really called me.
Do you hear the voice calling your name only at specific places like home or the warehouse, or can it happen anywhere?
Mostly at home, from the hallway. It happened once at the warehouse too, when nobody was around. I don’t know if it could happen anywhere… those are just the places I’ve noticed.
Do you ever smell or taste anything that isn't really there?
No… I don’t think so. It’s not smells or tastes. It’s more the… hearing my name thing.
Have you experienced any traumatic events in your past?
I… I don’t really know. Nothing I’d want to get into, I guess. Not that I can think of right now.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are not your own or are being controlled by someone else?
I don’t think so. I mean… my thoughts feel like mine, I guess. I haven’t really noticed anything like somebody controlling them.
Have you ever had an episode in the past where you heard voices or saw things that weren't there for an extended period of time?

Not for, like, a long time, no. It’s more recently… I keep hearing my name called, from the hallway at home. And it happened once at the warehouse too, when nobody was there. It sounds real, like my husband is standing right next to me. That’s what scared me enough to come in.
